From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Subject: Vendr profile attestation and intake cadence — HelioForms

Hi Sara —

Thanks for agreeing to work with us on the Vendr profile. We want to get a short attestation run (SIG/CAIQ fragments + SOC2 cert) into Vendr and set a weekly follow-up cadence so we can keep the profile fresh through the procurement window.

Quick asks to prep the kickoff:
- Can you share a link to your Vendr account (or invite security@redwood.com) so we can claim the profile?
- Please upload any current SOC 2 report and a CAIQ export if you have one; if not, a short answers QNA export is fine.
- Any known scope exclusions (e.g., isolated product module, managed services) so we can map evidence correctly.

Proposed times for a 30-minute walkthrough next week (PDT):
- Tue Jul 6 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 7 14:00–14:30
- Thu Jul 8 11:00–11:30

I’ve attached a lightweight intake scope PDF that outlines the fields we’ll request and our suggested evidence manifest. Ben — can you create the HubSpot opportunity and tag this as Vendr intake? Kimberly — can you own the evidence ingestion once they upload?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: vendr-intake-scope.pdf (PDF, 340KB stub)

Hi Logan —

Thanks — happy to run this. We can invite security@redwood.com to our Vendr tenant; the admin is me (sara@helioforms.com).

Uploads we can provide immediately:
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted)
- CAIQ export (JSON) and a short QNA spreadsheet of controls we track internally

Scope note: our core inference product (HelioForms AI) is in scope. Our managed data labeling service is run by a subcontractor and excluded from SOC scope currently; I’ll include that in the manifest.

I’m available Wed Jul 7 at 14:00 PDT for the 30-minute walkthrough — that works best for our security lead, Miguel. Can you send a calendar invite and a Vendr invite to security@redwood.com?

—Sara
